title: V1/V2 parity manifest
description: Manifest of an explainability V1/V2 parity comparison (V1-05). It declares the campaign, the exclusive comparison key, the JSONL exports to compare, the expected event identities and the numeric tolerances. The comparison itself never widens a tolerance and never invents a SHAP comparison for a non-computed status.

campaign.description: Campaign name carried into the report envelope.

comparison_key.description: Exclusive identity key. No timestamp fallback, no coercion: both parts must be real non-empty strings.

v1.description: Path of the V1 JSONL export (one JSON object per non-empty line). Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory; the CLI rejects a missing file with a distinct error.

v2.description: Path of the V2 JSONL export (one JSON object per non-empty line). Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory; the CLI rejects a missing file with a distinct error.

items.description: Expected event identity, exactly one 'Group|source_event_id' with no empty part.

expected_keys.description: Non-empty, duplicate-free list of the identities the campaign must deliver on both sides.

absolute_tolerance.description: Maximum absolute gap still tolerated as technical parity (atol check first).

relative_tolerance.description: Maximum relative gap still tolerated as technical parity, checked only when the denominator is non-zero.

numeric_tolerances.description: Numeric tolerances applied by the comparator; both must be >= 0.
